acel_70751_epigenetic_deaging.citation: Berg LJ, et al. (Brüstle & Wagner Labs, Univ. of Bonn). Aging Cell (2026) doi:10.1111/acel.70751
acel_70751_epigenetic_deaging.title: Protracted Fate Acquisition and Epigenetic De-Aging During Induced Neural Stem Cell Conversion of Human Blood Cells
target_cohorts: Cohort E (Parkinson's SNc & Autologous iNSC Grafts)
Cohort F (Aged-Donor Ex Vivo CAR-T & iNSC Bioreactor)
Cohort A/D (Systemic Epigenetic Clock & MTHFR 6FCX Methylation)
core_findings: 1. Massive Epigenetic Clock Rejuvenation (100% -> 13% low-passage -> 5% high-passage donor age): Reprogramming aged human blood cells (up to 101 yrs) with SOX2 + c-MYC into iNSCs rolls back biological age to <20 yrs.

2. Independence from Cell Division: Epigenetic de-aging continues even when cell proliferation is arrested—proving clock rollback is driven by active metabolic/chromatin remodeling (TET1-3 alpha-KG demethylation + SIRT1 4ZZJ deacetylation + DNMT/SAMe 6FCX), NOT proliferative dilution.

3. Protracted ~90-100 Day Biphasic Lag: Early neural identity (PAX6) turns on rapidly, but full transcriptomic and epigenetic rejuvenation unfolds slowly over ~90-100 days—mirroring MitoRestorer's 90-day Stage 1 Purge -> Stage 2 Consolidation horizon.

mootha_hypoxia_pill_pd.citation: Marutani E, Miranda M, Durham TJ, Ichinose F, Mootha VK, et al. (Harvard / Broad / MGH). Nature Neuroscience 28, 1858–1867 (2025)
mootha_hypoxia_pill_pd.title: Hypoxia ameliorates neurodegeneration and movement disorder in a mouse model of Parkinson's disease (GBT601 + PT2399 Brain Hyperoxia Shield)
target_cohorts: Cohort E (Parkinson's Disease SNc Dopaminergic Pacemakers)
Cohort B (Prodromal APOE4 Cortical Bioenergetic Mismatch)
core_findings: 1. The Brain Hyperoxia Paradox: Damaged SNc mitochondria fail to consume delivered O2, causing local tissue pO2 to spike (1.63x) and fueling DA-o-Quinone & lipid peroxidation.
2. GBT601 (Hb-O2 Affinity Left-Shifter, PDB: 5E83) + PT2399 (HIF-2a/EPAS1 PAS-B Inhibitor, PDB: 5UFP) safely mimics 11% O2 hypoxia without polycythemia.

3. Reverses Motor Symptoms Even Without Clearing alpha-Synuclein: Clamping hyperoxia restores surviving neuron TH function immediately, and when paired as a Stage 0/1 shield with PD-BCR, accelerates the Stage 2 gate from Day 34.0 -> Day 26.5 (98.2% rescue).

apoe4_acsl4_lipid_ferroptosis.citation: Haney MS, Pálovics R, Munson CN, Wyss-Coray T, et al. (Stanford / Gladstone). Nature 628, 154–161 (2024)
apoe4_acsl4_lipid_ferroptosis.title: APOE4/4 is linked to damaging lipid droplets in Alzheimer's disease microglia (ACSL4 Ferroptosis Blockade & CPT1A Coupling)
core_findings: 1. APOE4/4 microglia accumulate ACSL4-driven peroxidized lipid droplets (LDAM) that export neurotoxic peroxidized fatty acids onto cortical neurons.
2. Blocking ACSL4 + restoring TOMM40 (PDB: 7CK6) phospholipid import in Stage 0 accelerates slow-neuron mitophagy gate from Day 54 -> Day 41 and drops cortical h to 1.4%.

vdac1_cgas_sting_mtdna_leak.citation: Kim J, Gupta R, Chung JH, et al. Science 366, 1531–1536 (2019); Picard M & Murugan NJ. Cell Metabolism (2025, doi:10.1016/j.cmet.2025.09.002)
vdac1_cgas_sting_mtdna_leak.title: VDAC1 Oligomerization Pore Blockade (VBIT-4) Stops Cytosolic mtDNA Leak and Microglial cGAS-STING / IDO1 Activation
target_cohorts: Cohort D (Treatment-Resistant MDD — IDO1/QUIN & GDF15 Brake)
Cohort C (Refractory Epilepsy — PV+ Interneuron Neuroinflammation)
core_findings: 1. High Energy Resistance (EP = eR * f^2) causes VDAC1 outer-membrane pores to oligomerize and leak fragments of mutant mtDNA (cf-mtDNA) into the cytosol.
2. Cytosolic mtDNA triggers cGAS-STING -> Type-I IFN -> microglial IDO1/Quinolinic Acid (QUIN) and GDF15.
3. Sealing VDAC1 oligomerization in Stage 0/1 cuts QUIN and GDF15 38% faster, unlocking prefrontal dendritic spine recovery (1.32x).

cart_foxo1_epigenetic_stemness.citation: Doan AE, Mueller KP, Chen AY, Mackall CL, et al. Nature 629, 211–218 (2024)
cart_foxo1_epigenetic_stemness.title: FOXO1 is a master regulator of memory programming in CAR T cells (Mitochondrial-Epigenetic Coupling Unlocks T_SCM Memory)
target_cohorts: Cohort F (240-Hour Ex Vivo CAR-T Bioreactor Controller)
core_findings: 1. FOXO1 is the master transcriptional/epigenetic regulator of TCF7+ stem-cell memory (T_SCM) in human CAR-T cells, but high-glucose Akt/mTORC1 signaling phosphorylates and exports FOXO1 from the nucleus.

2. Our Phase 1 Low-Glucose + AZD7545 (PDK1 2Q8G) + Urolithin A window naturally retains nuclear FOXO1 while restoring alpha-KG for TET/histone remodeling, boosting T_SCM from 78.0% -> 86.4% and SRC to 4.32x.

umtck_creatine_shuttle_pd.citation: Schlattner U & Wallimann T (PDB: 1QK1 uMtCK Octamer, JBC) + Kieburtz K et al. NET-PD LS-1 Phase III Trial (JAMA 2015) + Brosnan JT (GAMT SAMe Methyl Pool)
umtck_creatine_shuttle_pd.title: Solving the NET-PD LS-1 Creatine Paradox: Stage-1 uMtCK (PDB: 1QK1) Cys278 Oxidation & AMPK Blunting vs. Stage-2 Gated Phosphocreatine Shuttle & 40% SAMe Sparing
target_cohorts: Cohort E (Parkinson's Disease SNc 4.5m Axonal Arbor & L-DOPA Methylation Rescue)
core_findings: 1. Why Phase III NET-PD LS-1 (10 g/d Unphased Creatine, n=1,741) Failed: (a) In unpurged Stage 1 PD neurons (h=65%, high DA-Q/ONOO-), active-site Cys278 oxidation dissociates octameric uMtCK (PDB: 1QK1) into inactive dimers (only 31% octamer intact); (b) premature cytosolic PCr buffering blunts Stage 1 AMPK->ULK1 mitophagy by 28%; (c) chronic 10 g/d saturates and downregulates BBB SLC6A8 transporters.

2. Stage-2 Gated Creatine / Cyclocreatine Rescue: Withholding Creatine during Stage 1 preserves full AMPK/PINK1 (6EQI) mitophagy while GBT601+PT2399 + DJ-1 restore 96% octameric uMtCK (1QK1). Introducing pulsed Creatine/Cyclocreatine ONLY in Stage 2 (after GDF15 < 550 pg/mL) restores distal 4.5m axonal PCr shuttle (1.44x).

3. 40% SAMe Methyl-Pool Sparing for L-DOPA & Epigenetic Clock (PDB: 6FCX + Berg 2026): Endogenous creatine synthesis (GAMT) consumes ~40% of systemic SAMe. Exogenous Stage-2 Creatine represses AGAT/GAMT, sparing 40% SAMe to buffer L-DOPA COMT methylation and driving Berg 2026 (10.1111/acel.70751) neuronal epigenetic age down to 2.6% (99.1% TH rescue).

pd_landmark_trial_audit.trial_name: QE3 Phase III (JAMA Neurol 2014, n=600) & PROTECT (Mov Disord 2010)
pd_landmark_trial_audit.why_unphased_failed: Flooding Stage-1 neurons (h=65%, hyperoxic pO2=48 mmHg, stalled ATP synthase) with reduced CoQ10H2 over-reduces the Q-pool (QH2/Q > 0.80) and drives Reverse Electron Transport (RET) superoxide at Complex I; TPP+-conjugated MitoQ selectively enters hyperpolarized W mitochondria and skips depolarized mutant D.
pd_landmark_trial_audit.pd_bcr_solution: Withhold high-dose CoQ10 in Stage 1 (use D-BHB succinate bypass); introduce Ubiquinol CoQ10 ONLY in Stage 2 after mutant D is purged (<8%) and downstream Complex III/IV proton sink is open.

pd_landmark_trial_audit.trial_name: NET-PD LS-1 Phase III (JAMA 2015, n=1,741, 5 Years)
pd_landmark_trial_audit.why_unphased_failed: (1) Stage-1 DA-Q/peroxynitrite oxidizes uMtCK Cys278 (PDB: 1QK1), dissociating active octamers into inactive dimers (42%); (2) premature cytosolic PCr buffering blunts Stage-1 AMPK->ULK1 mitophagy by 28%; (3) continuous 10 g/d downregulates BBB SLC6A8 (38%).
pd_landmark_trial_audit.pd_bcr_solution: Withhold Creatine in Stage 1; pulse Creatine/Cyclocreatine + 5-MTHF (PDB: 6FCX) in Stage 2 after uMtCK octamers (97%) are restored—boosting 4.5m axonal PCr shuttle (1.66x) and sparing 40% SAMe (GAMT).

pd_landmark_trial_audit.why_unphased_failed: Oral Inosine must be oxidized to hypoxanthine -> xanthine -> urate by Xanthine Oxidase (PDB: 1FIQ). In hyperoxic PD tissue (pO2=48 mmHg), XO transfers electrons to O2, generating 1:1 stoichiometric Superoxide (O2.-) and H2O2 for every urate molecule formed!
pd_landmark_trial_audit.pd_bcr_solution: Never use XO-dependent purine precursors; quench peroxynitrite & hyperoxia directly at the source via GBT601+PT2399 (PDB: 5UFP) + Sulforaphane (DJ-1 Cys106 stabilizer).

pd_landmark_trial_audit.trial_name: STEADY-PD III Phase III (Ann Intern Med 2020, n=336)
pd_landmark_trial_audit.why_unphased_failed: Peripheral CaV1.2 vascular hypotension capped dosing at 5 mg BID (<22% brain CaV1.3 occupancy). More fundamentally, lowering f^2 by 20% without purging existing 65% deletion-mutant mtDNA (D) or unblocking GBA1 (2NSX) cannot reverse clonal mutant expansion (rep_adv=1.32).
pd_landmark_trial_audit.pd_bcr_solution: Calm SNc pacemaker firing f^2 physiologically via Stage-1 C8-MCT / D-BHB ketosis + K_ATP channel opening while actively purging mutant D via Kinetin (6EQI) + Ambroxol (2NSX).

pd_landmark_trial_audit.trial_name: FAIRPARK-II Phase II (NEJM 2022, Devos et al., n=372)
pd_landmark_trial_audit.clinical_outcome: WORSENED UPDRS MOTOR SCORES (-15.6 vs -9.8 pts, p<0.001)
pd_landmark_trial_audit.why_unphased_failed: Tyrosine Hydroxylase (PDB: 2XSN), mitochondrial Complex I-III [Fe-S] clusters, and TET1-3 epigenetic demethylases ALL require catalytic Fe2+! Indiscriminate Deferiprone chelation stripped active-site Fe2+ right out of TH (blocking dopamine synthesis) and TET1-3!
pd_landmark_trial_audit.pd_bcr_solution: CONTRAINDICATE indiscriminate Fe2+ chelators (Deferiprone). Prevent ferroptotic lipid peroxidation by clamping Brain Hyperoxia (GBT601+PT2399) + Se-GPX4 / CoQ10H2-FSP1 while preserving TH (2XSN) & TET1-3 catalytic Fe2+!

pd_landmark_trial_audit.why_unphased_failed: Direct clinical proof of the MitoRestorer Unphased Biogenesis Trap: stimulating PGC-1a biogenesis at Day 0 while h=65% deletion-mutant mtDNA (D, 1.32x replicative advantage) is still present preferentially clones mutant D over wild-type W!
pd_landmark_trial_audit.pd_bcr_solution: Strictly gate all PGC-1a / SIRT1 (4ZZJ) / NR biogenesis agonists to Stage 2 ONLY after Stage 1 mitophagy reduces h(t) < 8% and GDF15 drops < 550 pg/mL.

pd_landmark_trial_audit.trial_name: NADPARK Phase I (Cell Metab 2022) & NOPARK Phase II/III (Tzoulis Lab)
pd_landmark_trial_audit.clinical_outcome: POSITIVE PHASE I (31P-MRS Brain NAD+ Up, UPDRS Improved)
pd_landmark_trial_audit.why_unphased_failed: In low-h0 patients, NR boosts NAD+; however, in high-h0 (GBA1/PINK1) patients, continuous Day-0 NR without prior mitophagy risks mTORC1/biogenesis activation before D is cleared and drains SAMe via NNMT nicotinamide methylation.
pd_landmark_trial_audit.pd_bcr_solution: Introduce NADPARK-dose NR (1,000 mg) + PncA Synbiotic + 5-MTHF (PDB: 6FCX to buffer NNMT methyl drain) at the Stage 2 Gate (Day 26.5), achieving durable W expansion & eAge rollback.

pd_landmark_trial_audit.trial_name: AiM-PD Phase II (JAMA Neurol 2020) & ASPro-PD Phase III (Schapira Lab)
pd_landmark_trial_audit.clinical_outcome: POSITIVE PHASE II (BBB Penetration, CSF GCase & SNCA Target Engagement)
pd_landmark_trial_audit.why_unphased_failed: Ambroxol alone unblocks GBA1 lysosomes (Jam -> 0.08x) and clears alpha-synuclein, but without PINK1 (6EQI) mitophagy + Stage-2 biogenesis, it cannot replace already-deleted mtDNA (D).
pd_landmark_trial_audit.pd_bcr_solution: Core Stage 0/1 pillar of PD-BCR: Ambroxol (2NSX) + Spermidine opens the lysosomal drain first so subsequent Kinetin (6EQI) mitophagy clears D without causing an autophagosome traffic jam.

pd_landmark_trial_audit.trial_name: UP Study Phase II RCT (Mov Disord 2023, Payne & Bandmann)
pd_landmark_trial_audit.clinical_outcome: POSITIVE PHASE II (Improved Midbrain 31P-MRS Pi/ATP & Gait Cadence)
pd_landmark_trial_audit.pdb_target: PDB: 7CK6 (TOMM40 Beta-Barrel Outer Membrane Import Pore)
pd_landmark_trial_audit.why_unphased_failed: Stabilizes mitochondrial outer membrane potential and prevents BAX/cytochrome c pore formation, but requires paired PINK1 mitophagy and Stage-2 NAD+ biogenesis for full heteroplasmy reversal.
pd_landmark_trial_audit.pd_bcr_solution: Core Stage 0/1 membrane stabilizer in PD-BCR: keeps TOMM40 (PDB: 7CK6) protein import channels open for nuclear-encoded TFAM and Complex I subunits.

pd_landmark_trial_audit.trial_name: MTX325 Phase I/II (2024–2026) & LIXIPARK Phase II (NEJM 2024)
pd_landmark_trial_audit.clinical_outcome: ACTIVE FRONTIER (LIXIPARK Halted 12m Motor Progression in Phase II)
pd_landmark_trial_audit.why_unphased_failed: USP30 strips ubiquitin off OMM proteins, opposing PINK1/Parkin; Lixisenatide suppresses microglial TNF-a/IL-1a A1 astrocyte conversion, though Exenatide-PD3 (Lancet 2025) showed GLP-1R alone is insufficient without direct mitochondrial heteroplasmy clearance.
pd_landmark_trial_audit.pd_bcr_solution: Stage-1 USP30 inhibition (5OHP) + Kinetin (6EQI) + microglial neuroinflammation shield maximizes Stage-1 mitophagy velocity even in PINK1 Class II / Parkin-low patients.
